allow: PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' }; if \($conn\) { $conn | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path | Format-List } else { 'no listener' })
